verdict.rationale: Auto-enrichment of contact and company records is a fair axis for a CRM, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a native enrichment feature that fills in firmographic or contact data. The only nearby items are generic integrations (API, Zapier, 100+ integrations) and CSV import, which are building blocks or workarounds rather than enrichment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
